newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intercargo estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intercargo estimate cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it cut its estimate on Intercargo Corp to $0.63 from $1.00 after the comapny reported disappointing third-quarter results.
-- The new 1996 estimate of $0.63 a share compares with $0.23 in 1995, excluding capital gains. EVEREN analyst Frederick Sandburg said the 1997 estimate remains $1.30 a share.
-- Earlier this month, Intercargo reported third quarter earnings of $0.09 a share, down from $0.21 a year ago. EVEREN said the third quarter results were well below its estimate of $0.30 a share.
-- EVEREN retains its market performer rating.
